author: Ari Koslow
title: Blaze Alexander (knee) suffers muscle contusion
desc: Orioles manager Craig Albernaz said Blaze Alexander has a muscle contusion from the foul ball off his knee.
impact: Albernaz added that he expects Alexander to be fine. He is day-to-day going into Tuesday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Emilio Pagan (hamstring) throws 25-pitch live BP session Monday
desc: Emilio Pagan threw 25 pitches in live batting practice session on Monday.
impact: Pagan confirmed he will begin his rehab assignment Thursday with Triple-A Louisville. He could be activated this weekend or early next week.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Kendall George rehabbing from injury
desc: Dodgers OF prospect Kendall George has been rehabbing at team's Arizona complex and is on track to return after All-Star break.
impact: George suffered a patellar tendon injury in Double-A when he jumped out of the way of a bat-retrieving dog and landed awkwardly. He did not require surgery.

author: David Leisering
title: Merrill Kelly suffers seventh loss of season Monday
desc: Merrill Kelly allowed three runs on seven hits, walked three, and struck out two as the Diamondbacks dropped a 3-2 decision to the Cardinals on Monday.
impact: Kelly pitched in and out of trouble all evening as he allowed ten baserunners across six innings. The righthander has now lost each of his last four starts and he has not been in the win column since May 25 against San Francisco. Kelly is 0-4 with a 7.25 ERA in four starts this month, allowing 28 hits and posting a disappointing 11:9 K:BB ratio over 22.1 innings in June. In 13 starts this season, Kelly is 5-7 with a 5.71 ERA and just 44 strikeouts in 75.2 innings. He's lined up to take on the Rays on Saturday in his next start.

author: David Leisering
title: Tommy Troy belts third home run of season Monday
desc: Tommy Troy went 1-for-4 with a solo home run on Monday as the Diamondbacks suffered a 3-2 loss to the Cardinals.
impact: Troy took Ryne Stanek deep in the seventh for his third home run of the season on Monday which proved to be his only hit of the day. In his first 25 career big league contests, Troy is batting .240 with three home runs and five runs batted in.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Tyler Alexander to serve as opener Tuesday
desc: Tyler Alexander will open for the Rangers on Tuesday against the Marlins.
impact: Alexander will start a second straight game after tossing a scoreless inning to open Monday's game.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Luis Rengifo placed on release waivers
desc: The Brewers placed Luis Rengifo on release waivers.
impact: Rengifo was designated for assignment. He'll figure to seek another opportunity.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Dalton Rushing passes initial concussion tests
desc: Dodgers manager Dave Roberts said Dalton Rushing passed initial concussion testing.
impact: Roberts said that the team will bring in an extra catcher just in case.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Kyle Tucker (back) not expected to undergo imaging
desc: Dodgers manager Dave Roberts said Kyle Tucker will not undergo imaging.
impact: Tucker left Monday's game early with low back spasms. He is day-to-day heading into Tuesday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Mick Abel (elbow) to seek second opinion
desc: Twins manager Derek Shelton said Mick Abel will seek a second opinion.
impact: Shelton said that Abel's MRI showed "he has swelling in his elbow joint, but no damage to the joint." He will seek a second opinion as a result.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Kendry Rojas to start Tuesday
desc: Kendry Rojas will start Tuesday's game against the Dodgers.
impact: Rojas was activated from the injured list over the weekend. He'll get the start on Tuesday with Joe Ryan (illness) scratched.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Joe Ryan (illness) scratched from start Tuesday
desc: Joe Ryan has been scratched from his scheduled start on Tuesday with an illness.
impact: Ryan is likely considered day-to-day. Kendry Rojas will start in his place.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Jeremy Pena left Monday's game with hamstring cramp
desc: Jeremy Pena left Monday's game against the Blue Jays with a right hamstring cramp.
impact: Pena was pulled from Monday's contest after fouling off a pitch in the top of the sixth, and the injury has been revealed as a right hamstring cramp. Fantasy managers can likely breathe a sigh of relief, as Pena should avoid an IL stint as long as it does not worsen in the next day or two.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ali Sanchez (wrist) has X-rays return negative
desc: The X-rays returned negative on Ali Sanchez's wrist injury.
impact: Sanchez is headed for a CT scan. He is day-to-day heading into Tuesday.
